derivation: The consolidated financial statements provide only the total PP&E carrying amounts on the balance sheet ($168,420,000 for 2025 and $161,905,000 for 2024) and an aggregated depreciation and amortisation expense line ($18,195,000 / $18,195,445.38) that combines depreciation with amortisation of intangibles.
